title: Modern 4 units 2 min to DT, 2 Rooftops, Garage
description:
* PRICE INCLUDES ALL 4 UNITS! *

Superhost for 5 years brings you these Beautiful luxurious NEW townhouses with an AMAZING Nashville Skyline view ROOFTOPS

- 1 Mile to Downtown Nashville
- Gated Community
- Large space for 34 guests comfortably 
- Fully equipped kitchens
- High-speed internet
- 2 car garages + 4 Reserved parking
- Huge Rooftops with TV, comfortable patio furniture, chaise lounges. Breathtaking Skyline view
- $7-10 Uber/Lyft ride to Broadway and all the hot locations

The space
The Layout of each townhome is similar, each with its own unique set of benefits and features.  

• Each space has a fully equipped kitchen complete with dinnerware, pots and pans, and a Keurig coffee maker. Coffee included!  
• The living rooms have pull-out sleeper sofas with bedding provided so that’s one less thing you have to worry about packing! 
• The second floor of each unit has all the bedrooms and full baths. The bathrooms come with towels for your convenience. 
• Washer/Dryer in all units if you find yourself needing those accommodations. Detergent is included.  
• Select units have balconies overlooking the courtyard. Inquire for specific listings. 
• Our favorite part of these units is the 2 rooftops that give you a view of Nashville’s skyline. Flat-screen TVs line the walls. Plenty of seating for all! 
• This location offers a great view of Nashville’s Nationally acclaimed fireworks show. 
• Garage available for you if you decide to get a rental. Some parking is available inside the gated community and ample street parking.

Guest access
You'll have full access to the entire units

Other things to note
You will receive a welcome message with all the necessary information including the access codes 48 hours before your arrival.

* GREAT FOR LARGE GROUPS *
We own many units in the complex. Large beautiful NEW townhomes with the capability of holding 50+ guests. We have accommodations that can fit any group size, so please inquire and we will find the best option for you!
